past_2_weeks.headline: Wall Street inches lower as Chair Warsh delivers a hawkish inflation warning at Jackson Hole. Major indices pulled back on Friday as investors digested Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh's debut speech. Warsh emphasized that the central bank remains fiercely committed to crushing sticky core inflation, stating that if price pressures do not steadily head toward the 2% goal, the Fed still has "more work to do". Short-term bond yields spiked, cooling down the tech-led momentum from earlier in the week.
